node.opening: I heard something about survivors moving nearby.
node.details: The story changes depending on who tells it: traders, refugees, or raiders.
node.personal: Unknown people make me more uneasy than the dead. The dead are predictable.
node.followup: Rumor or not, someone has been leaving fresh signs along the road.
node.closing: If we meet them, the first minute will decide a lot.
choice.personal: Why does this bother you so much?
choice.offer_help: I can investigate without provoking anyone.
choice.reassure: We'll face them together if they come here.
choice.challenge: We cannot treat every stranger like an enemy.
response.detail.open: Two people with packs, avoiding open ground and marking turns with blue cloth.
response.detail.guarded: Only that there are people out there who don't want to be followed.
response.personal.open: Because a living person can smile while deciding what to take from you.
response.personal.guarded: Experience. That's enough of an answer.
response.offer_help.open: Quiet observation would tell us more than another round of rumors.
response.offer_help.guarded: Investigate if you must, but don't lead them back here.
response.press.open: The blue cloth and the route. Those details came from separate people.
response.press.guarded: The timing matches. Everything else may be decoration.
response.reassure.open: Together is better than wondering who will stand their ground.
response.reassure.guarded: We'll see who stands where when it matters.
response.challenge.open: No, but we should decide slowly who earns trust.
response.challenge.guarded: And we cannot pretend every stranger arrives with good intentions.
response.advice.open: Visible hands, cover nearby, and one speaker instead of a shouting crowd.
response.advice.guarded: From a distance, with an exit route.
response.wrap_up.open: Waiting is reasonable while the signs remain distant.
response.wrap_up.guarded: Fine. Rumors can stay rumors for now.
response.promise.open: Good. Caution now may prevent blood later.
response.leave.open: Look for blue cloth, but don't touch it.
locked.personal: You do not know each other well enough for that question.
locked.skill: You need more Foraging experience to compare the trail details.
locked.personality: This NPC is not receptive to being challenged this way.
locked.promise: They do not trust your promises yet.
